items.title: At least 100 deaths reported in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo as six Americans exposed
items.description: One of the six Americans is experiencing symptoms, according to media reports. One province in Congo reports 390 cases.

items.title: What is Ebola and why is stopping this outbreak so difficult?
items.description: An outbreak of Ebola in DR Congo involves a rare strain and is in an area affected by conflict.

items.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
items.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

items.title: Judge rules gun and writings are admissible in Luigi Mangione's New York murder trial
items.description: Other items found with Mangione at a Pennsylvania McDonald's will not be allowed to be presented in court, the judge ruled.

items.title: Two men arrested over stunt at enclosure of famous monkey Punch
items.description: Two US nationals have been arrested after one jumped the fence of the monkey, who went viral online, police say.

items.title: Shakira wins £50m tax refund from Spanish government
items.description: The Colombian singer says the court ruling means the "narrative" that she was guilty now "crumbles".

items.title: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt booed by graduates at mention of AI
items.description: The reaction underscores a growing anxiety among students over AI's impact on jobs and their future careers.

items.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
items.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.

items.title: Bodies of missing Italian divers found in Maldives
items.description: The bodies of all five Italian divers who died in the Maldives last week have now been found, officials tell the BBC.

items.title: Israeli forces board Gaza-bound flotilla near Cyprus, activists say
items.description: Live broadcasts from the Global Sumud flotilla show commandos boarding several boats trying to breach the Gaza maritime blockade.

items.title: Trump warns 'clock is ticking' for Iran as peace progress stalls
items.description: On Monday Iran said it had responded to the latest US proposal and that exchanges with Washington were continuing.

items.title: Driver of crashed train tested positive for drugs, Thai police say
items.description: The freight train collided with a bus in Bangkok, killing eight people and injuring dozens of others.
